account_init.title: Configure Kaufland account
account_init.description: Optional but recommended: paste a session cookie value below to (1) let this integration actually activate free marketplace coupons automatically (without it, activation always fails with 'Missing session cookie'), and (2) also track in-store/regular Kaufland Card XTRA coupons for read-only display. Log into https://www.kaufland.de in a normal browser, open Developer Tools → Application/Storage → Cookies, find the cookie named 'ALTSESSID', and copy its value here. This cookie is short-lived and you will need to come back and refresh it whenever a repair issue says it's expired. Leave blank to disable both features.

account_reauth_required.description: The linked Kaufland account's login has expired or been revoked. Remove and re-add the account to keep auto-activating free coupons.

instore_cookie_invalid.title: Kaufland in-store coupons session cookie expired
instore_cookie_invalid.description: The manually-provided in-store coupons session cookie (ALTSESSID) was rejected or has expired. Log into https://www.kaufland.de in a browser, copy a fresh 'ALTSESSID' cookie value, and update it in the account's options to resume in-store coupon tracking.
